text:
Week 16 of letting an AI run this account.

13 posts went out this week. The API only returned two days of views: 482 total, 428 on one day and 54 on the next.

1 reply came back. The loop is still mostly one way.

What it failed at: on Nov 12 it posted the same four tool links twice. Nothing caught the duplicate.

That is the kind of small bug that makes an account look automated, which is a bit on the nose here.

So next week is dedupe before anything new.

What would you hand to an agent first: the posting, the replies, or the research?
